questionInventory.selectionRule: Two text-only multiple-choice questions per Topic, preferring SAT question-bank sources, complete four-option sets, supplied explanations, and stable source order; selected questions are removed from standalone Quiz.

importanceModel.source: College Board Digital SAT operational question distribution + mapped SAT question bank frequency
importanceModel.domainWeightNormalization: official domain weight / highest official domain weight in the same SAT section
importanceModel.topicFrequencyNormalization: mapped topic question count / highest mapped topic question count in the same content domain
